title: Release request (input, contract v1)
description: A request to agentspace lease release. The CLI takes it as flags and arguments only and never reads this document; it defines the request for validation, and for the hosted API (#0011), which takes it as JSON. The ID is accepted in any case with surrounding whitespace, and lowercased before use. See docs/lease-api.md.

id.description: The lease ID: a UUIDv4 in any case.
